summary: Evogene Ltd. filed Amendment No. 1 to Prospectus Supplement (424B5) to increase the maximum aggregate offering price from $2,926,500 to $3,288,113 under an existing at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The filing also updates the remaining capacity under General Instruction I.B.5. to $1,535,088.08. This is a routine shelf takedown adjustment with no special-situation event such as a merger or tender; it merely raises the ceiling on potential ordinary share sales. No premium, price per share, or structural terms are specified beyond the increased amount.
